title: Retention policy is deleting active project documents before their retention period ends
description: The retention policy applied to the Project Documents class is marking and scheduling documents for deletion even though they are still active projects. Three documents from ongoing 2024 projects were already deleted last week. We believe the trigger date configuration is wrong.

worklogs.description: Reviewed retention policy configuration in ACCE. Found the retention trigger is set to 'Create Date' instead of 'Project Close Date' custom property.
Halted the retention job via ACCE to prevent further deletions while the policy is corrected.
Attempted to restore the 3 deleted documents from the archive storage. Two recovered, one was permanently purged.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: This is very serious. Three documents from active projects were deleted and we only noticed because a project manager went looking for them. How many more are scheduled for deletion? Can we stop it?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I have immediately halted the retention job to prevent any further deletions. No more documents will be deleted until we fix the policy configuration. I can see 47 more documents in the deletion queue - they are safe for now. I found the configuration error: the retention trigger was set to use the document Create Date instead of the Project Close Date property. A document created 2 years ago is treated as 2 years old regardless of whether the project is still active.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Can we recover the 3 documents that were already deleted?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I am checking the archive storage now. FileNet typically keeps deleted documents in a second-stage recycle for 30 days. I found two of the three documents and am restoring them now. Unfortunately the third document was a smaller one that was permanently purged immediately after deletion due to its document class settings. I will need you to re-upload that document. Could you tell me the document title so I can create a placeholder for your records?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: The lost document was 'Project Harmony - Scope Agreement v1.2'. We have a local copy saved on the project manager's PC. We can re-upload it once the policy is fixed.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Good that you have a local copy. I am correcting the retention policy now to use the Project Close Date property as the trigger instead of Create Date. Once corrected, I will clear the deletion queue and re-evaluate which documents should actually be scheduled for retention. The 47 documents in the queue will all be reviewed against the corrected policy.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Policy corrected: trigger changed from 'Create Date' to 'Project Close Date' property. Cleared the deletion queue. Re-running the retention evaluation - 0 documents now meet the retention criteria since no projects have a Close Date older than the retention period. Two previously deleted documents restored to their original location.
